name: app-in-a-box
description: Turn an app idea into a provisioned, instrumented, CI-gated Expo + FastAPI + Supabase repo with a full agent harness.

interface.shortDescription: Idea → production-grade mobile app repo in about an hour
interface.longDescription: Interviews you about the idea, renders design directions, walks you through free-tier accounts, scaffolds Expo + FastAPI + Supabase with auth, analytics and error monitoring, provisions the cloud resources, and installs CI, PR review, skills, subagents, hooks and memory that work in both Codex and Claude Code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $new-app to build my app idea in this folder.
